league_env.attempts: (SB + CS) / (2 x games), stolen_base_* as SB, caught_stealing_* and pickoff_caught_stealing_* as CS, one count per runner event
league_env.source: the pitch sidecar (.cache/pbp_physics), as labelled in MLB's feed

policy.dates: every Sunday from the third Sunday of May to the season's last game
policy.flag: |z / phi| at or above the bar and the size (the shrunk change, or the change net of drift with no fit) at or above the family's floor

prior_season.dates: every Sunday from the first Sunday on or after April 6 to May 18

rp_ivb.label: Fastball induced vertical break, last 6 outings

sp_ivb.label: Fastball induced vertical break, last 3 starts

shrink.method: two-group prior: a point mass at no change with weight pi0 and a normal spread tau; mix against the placebo's own selected max-of-three null

what: League Trends' false-trend calibration: per family, the real tests and R seeded placebo shuffles at every weekly Sunday from the third Sunday of May, as of each date, the bar chosen in code by the stated policy, and the live season's held-out check.
